source_read: https://www.pret.co.uk/en-GB/products (fresh fetch 2026-10-08 of the 11 category data files, robots.txt allows /en-GB/products; plus 24 live product pages rendered in Chromium and read as visible text)
not_verifiable: Non-default milk/decaf variants of barista drinks are not shown by the site's product pages (only the default variant renders), so those 131 variants were compared with the site's own data by an independent parser, not with a rendered page. Pret is link-only for allergens (none published), so no allergen marks were checked.
notes: Fresh data reproduces items.csv exactly (no drift since 2026-10-06). Independent parse of the raw data (nutritionalData for 198 plain products = 1,782 cells; variant tables for the 131 drink variants = 1,190 cells): 0 mismatches. 22 plain items from two random samples + Americano and Cappuccino pages: all 9 printed values per item equal the rendered table (198 cells), vegetarian marks equal the page. Held back Macchiato (soya milk, decaf): the data prints 7 kJ with 4 kcal (its caffeinated twin prints 17 kJ); pret.py now holds back any item whose kJ and kcal contradict (we publish kJ). Roasted Mushroom Baked Beans & Egg Pot kcal warning explained: 4P+4C+9F+2 kcal/g fibre = 190.8 vs 191 printed.
